    ———————– Process manager (QProcess logging) ———————–

    class ProcessManagerLocal(QtCore.QObject): status_updated = QtCore.Signal() bulk_stop_finished = QtCore.Signal() log_received = QtCore.Signal(int, str) # (port, text)

    def __init__(self, data_dir: Path, parent=None):
    super().__init__(parent)
    self.data_dir = data_dir
    self.instances: Dict[int, Instance] = {}
    (self.data_dir / "instances").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (self.data_dir / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (self.data_dir / "tmp").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # faster tick so STARTING→RUNNING flips as soon as port is listening
    self.poll_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
    self.poll_timer.timeout.connect(self.poll_status)
    self.poll_timer.start(800)

    self._bulk_stop_check_timer: Optional[QtCore.QTimer] = None

def create_instance(self) -> Instance:
    if len(self.instances) >= MAX_INSTANCES:
        raise RuntimeError("Maximum number of instances reached.")
    port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
    if is_port_in_use(port):
        port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
    name = f"HyperFlow-{port}"
    cwd = self.data_dir / "instances" / name
    cwd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_path = self.data_dir / "logs" / f"{name}.log"
    inst = Instance(name=name, port=port, cwd=cwd, log_path=log_path)
    self.instances[port] = inst
    return inst

def start_instance(self, inst: Instance):
    if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
        return
    if is_port_in_use(inst.port):
        new_port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
        if is_port_in_use(new_port):
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Port Error", "Failed to acquire a free port. Please try again.")
            return
        inst.port = new_port

    cmd = COMFYUI_EXEC.format(port=inst.port)

    p = QtCore.QProcess(self)
    p.setWorkingDirectory(COMFYUI_WORKDIR)
    p.setProcessChannelMode(QtCore.QProcess.MergedChannels)
    p.setProgram("/bin/bash")
    p.setArguments(["-lc", cmd])

    def _on_ready():
        try:
            data = bytes(p.readAllStandardOutput()).decode("utf-8", "ignore")
        except Exception:
            return
        if not data:
            return
        # (optional) also persist to file
        if inst.log_fh is None:
            try:
                inst.log_fh = open(inst.log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8")
            except Exception:
                inst.log_fh = None
        if inst.log_fh:
            try:
                inst.log_fh.write(data); inst.log_fh.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.log_received.emit(inst.port, data)

    def _on_finished(code, status):
        if inst.log_fh:
            try: inst.log_fh.close()
            except Exception: pass
            inst.log_fh = None
        inst.proc = None
        inst.pid = None
        inst.status = "STOPPED"
        for pid in list(inst.chrome_pids):
            try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            except ProcessLookupError: pass
        inst.chrome_pids.clear()
        self.status_updated.emit()

    p.readyReadStandardOutput.connect(_on_ready)
    p.finished.connect(_on_finished)

    inst.status = "STARTING"
    p.start()
    if not p.waitForStarted(3000):
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Start Error", "Failed to start process.")
        inst.status = "STOPPED"
        return
    inst.proc = p
    inst.pid = int(p.processId()) if p.processId() is not None else None
    self.status_updated.emit()

def stop_instance_async(self, inst: Instance, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
    if not inst.proc:
        return
    try:
        inst.proc.terminate()
    except Exception:
        pass
    pid = inst.pid

    def _force_kill():
        if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            if pid:
                try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError: pass
            try: inst.proc.kill()
            except Exception: pass

    QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(int(timeout_sec * 1000), _force_kill)

def kill_all_async(self, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
    running = [i for i in self.instances.values() if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
    if not running:
        QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self.bulk_stop_finished.emit)
        return

    if self._bulk_stop_check_timer is None:
        self._bulk_stop_check_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)

    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.setInterval(300)

    def _tick():
        alive = [i for i in self.instances.values() if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
        if not alive:
            self._bulk_stop_check_timer.stop()
            self.bulk_stop_finished.emit()

    try:
        self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.disconnect()
    except Exception:
        pass
    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.connect(_tick)
    self._bulk_stop_check_timer.start()

    for inst in running:
        self.stop_instance_async(inst, timeout_sec)

def poll_status(self):
    changed = False
    for inst in self.instances.values():
        prev = inst.status
        if not inst.proc or inst.proc.state() == QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            if prev != "STOPPED":
                inst.status = "STOPPED"; changed = True
            continue
        inst.status = "RUNNING" if is_port_in_use(inst.port) else "STARTING"
        if inst.status != prev:
            changed = True
    if changed:
        self.status_updated.emit()

def open_web(self, inst: Instance, browser_path: str):
    url = f"http://localhost:{inst.port}"
    try:
        p = subprocess.Popen([browser_path, url])
        inst.chrome_pids.append(p.pid)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(None, "Browser Not Found", f"The browser path is invalid:\n{browser_path}")

    ———————– UI widgets ———————–

    class InstanceCard(QtWidgets.QFrame): start_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int) stop_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int) openweb_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, inst: Instance, procman: ProcessManagerLocal, parent=None):
    super().__init__(parent)
    self.inst = inst
    self.procman = procman
    self.setObjectName("card")
    self.setAttribute(QtCore.Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
    self._anim_tick = 0

    name_lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel(f"{inst.name}"); name_lbl.setObjectName("h2")
    self.subtitle = QtWidgets.QLabel(self._subtitle_text()); self.subtitle.setObjectName("subtle")

    self.start_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Start")
    self.stop_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Stop")
    self.web_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Open Web")

    self.start_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.start_clicked.emit(inst.port))
    self.stop_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.stop_clicked.emit(inst.port))
    self.web_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.openweb_clicked.emit(inst.port))

    # Console toggle + view
    self.console_toggle = QtWidgets.QToolButton()
    self.console_toggle.setObjectName("consoleToggle")
    self.console_toggle.setText("Console")
    self.console_toggle.setCheckable(True)
    self.console_toggle.setArrowType(QtCore.Qt.RightArrow)
    self.console_toggle.setToolButtonStyle(QtCore.Qt.ToolButtonTextBesideIcon)
    self.console_toggle.toggled.connect(self._on_console_toggled)

    self.console_view = QtWidgets.QTextBrowser()
    self.console_view.setObjectName("console")
    self.console_view.setReadOnly(True)
    self.console_view.setHidden(True)
    self.console_view.document().setMaximumBlockCount(5000)
    self.console_view.setAutoFillBackground(False)

    header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
    header.addWidget(name_lbl); header.addStretch(); header.addWidget(self.subtitle)

    actions = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
    actions.addStretch()
    actions.addWidget(self.start_btn)
    actions.addWidget(self.stop_btn)
    actions.addWidget(self.web_btn)
    actions.addWidget(self.console_toggle)

    v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
    v.addLayout(header)
    v.addLayout(actions)
    v.addWidget(self.console_view)

    # STARTING animation timer
    self.anim_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
    self.anim_timer.setInterval(1000)
    self.anim_timer.timeout.connect(self._animate_starting)
    self._sync_anim_timer()

    # connect live logs
    self.procman.log_received.connect(self._on_log)

    self.update_buttons()

def _subtitle_text(self) -> str:
    if self.inst.status == "STARTING":
        dots = "." * ((self._anim_tick % 3) + 1)
        return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: STARTING{dots}"
    return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: {self.inst.status}"

def _sync_anim_timer(self):
    if self.inst.status == "STARTING" and not self.anim_timer.isActive():
        self.anim_timer.start()
    elif self.inst.status != "STARTING" and self.anim_timer.isActive():
        self.anim_timer.stop()

def _animate_starting(self):
    if self.inst.status != "STARTING":
        self._sync_anim_timer(); return
    self._anim_tick += 1
    self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())

def _on_console_toggled(self, checked: bool):
    self.console_toggle.setArrowType(QtCore.Qt.DownArrow if checked else QtCore.Qt.RightArrow)
    self.console_view.setHidden(not checked)

@QtCore.Slot(int, str)
def _on_log(self, port: int, text: str):
    if port != self.inst.port:
        return
    html = ansi_to_html(text)
    self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)
    self.console_view.insertHtml(html)
    self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)

def update_view(self, inst: Instance):
    self.inst = inst
    self._sync_anim_timer()
    self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())
    self.update_buttons()

def update_buttons(self):
    running = self.inst.status == "RUNNING"
    starting = self.inst.status == "STARTING"
    self.start_btn.setEnabled(not running and not starting)
    self.stop_btn.setEnabled(running or starting)
    self.web_btn.setEnabled(running)

    class HyperFlowPage(QtWidgets.QWidget): def init(self, procman: ProcessManagerLocal, browser_path: str, parent=None): super().init(parent) self.procman = procman self.browser_path = browser_path self._auto_open_done = False

        title = QtWidgets.QLabel("HyperFlow"); title.setObjectName("h1")
    add_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("New Instance"); add_btn.setObjectName("primary"); add_btn.clicked.connect(self.on_add)

    header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(); header.addWidget(title); header.addStretch(); header.addWidget(add_btn)

    # Scrollable card list
    self.cards_container = QtWidgets.QWidget()
    self.cards_layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self.cards_container)
    self.cards_layout.setSpacing(10); self.cards_layout.addStretch(1)

    scroll = QtWidgets.QScrollArea()
    scroll.setWidget(self.cards_container)
    scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
    scroll.setFrameShape(QtWidgets.QFrame.NoFrame)
    scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
    # prevent opaque repaint from styles
    scroll.setAutoFillBackground(False)
    scroll.viewport().setAutoFillBackground(False)

    outer = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
    outer.addLayout(header)
    outer.addSpacing(8)
    outer.addWidget(scroll, 1)

    procman.status_updated.connect(self.refresh)

    # ensure at least one card; auto-start + auto-open web once RUNNING
    if not self.procman.instances:
        card = self.on_add()
        if card:
            QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(50, lambda: self._auto_start_and_open(card))

    self.refresh()

def on_add(self) -> Optional[InstanceCard]:
    try:
        inst = self.procman.create_instance()
    except Exception as e:
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(self, "Create Failed", str(e)); return None
    card = InstanceCard(inst, self.procman)
    # insert above the stretch
    self.cards_layout.insertWidget(self.cards_layout.count() - 1, card)

    # hook buttons
    card.start_clicked.connect(self.on_start)
    card.stop_clicked.connect(self.on_stop)
    card.openweb_clicked.connect(self.on_openweb)
    return card

def _auto_start_and_open(self, card: InstanceCard):
    inst = card.inst
    self.procman.start_instance(inst)

    def maybe_open():
        if self._auto_open_done:
            return
        cur = self.procman.instances.get(inst.port)
        if cur and cur.status == "RUNNING":
            self._auto_open_done = True
            self.procman.open_web(cur, self.browser_path)
            try: self.procman.status_updated.disconnect(maybe_open)
            except Exception: pass

    self.procman.status_updated.connect(maybe_open)

def on_start(self, port: int):
    inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
    if inst: self.procman.start_instance(inst)

def on_stop(self, port: int):
    inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
    if inst: self.procman.stop_instance_async(inst)

def on_openweb(self, port: int):
    inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
    if inst: self.procman.open_web(inst, self.browser_path)

@QtCore.Slot()
def refresh(self):
    for i in range(self.cards_layout.count() - 1):
        w = self.cards_layout.itemAt(i).widget()
        if isinstance(w, InstanceCard):
            inst = self.procman.instances.get(w.inst.port)
            if inst: w.update_view(inst)

    class SettingsWidget(QtWidgets.QWidget): request_restart = QtCore.Signal(Path) def init(self, config: ConfigManager, parent=None): super().init(parent); self.config = config title = QtWidgets.QLabel("Settings"); title.setObjectName("h1") data_label = QtWidgets.QLabel("Data Directory") self.data_edit = QtWidgets.QLineEdit(str(config.data_dir or "")) self.data_edit.setPlaceholderText("Path to HyperFlow data directory") data_browse = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Browse…"); data_browse.clicked.connect(self.on_browse) grid = QtWidgets.QGridLayout(); grid.addWidget(data_label,0,0); grid.addWidget(self.data_edit,0,1); grid.addWidget(data_browse,0,2) info = QtWidgets.QLabel("Changing the data directory will restart the launcher.") save_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Apply & Restart"); save_btn.clicked.connect(self.apply_and_restart) card = QtWidgets.QFrame(); card.setObjectName("card"); card.setAttribute(QtCore.Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True) card_l = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(card); card_l.addLayout(grid); card_l.addWidget(info); card_l.addStretch(); card_l.addWidget(save_btn, alignment=QtCore.Qt.AlignRight) v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self); v.addWidget(title); v.addSpacing(8); v.addWidget(card, 1) def on_browse(self): d = QtWidgets.QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select Data Directory") if d: self.data_edit.setText(d) def apply_and_restart(self): new_path = Path(self.data_edit.text().strip()) if not new_path.exists(): QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(self, "Invalid Path", "The selected path does not exist."); return self.request_restart.emit(new_path)

    self._create_tray()
    self.resize(1120, 720)
    self._apply_qss()

def _apply_qss(self):
    self.setStyleSheet(QSS)

def on_sidebar_index(self, idx: int): self.stack.setCurrentIndex(idx)

def _create_tray(self):
    self.tray = QtWidgets.QSystemTrayIcon(self)
    self.tray.setIcon(app_icon())
    self.tray.setToolTip(APP_NAME)
    self.tray.activated.connect(self.on_tray_activated)
    menu = QtWidgets.QMenu()
    show_act = menu.addAction("Show Window")
    quit_act = menu.addAction("Quit")
    show_act.triggered.connect(self.show_normal_from_tray)
    quit_act.triggered.connect(self.quit_app)
    self.tray.setContextMenu(menu)
    self.tray.show()

def on_tray_activated(self, reason):
    if reason == QtWidgets.QSystemTrayIcon.DoubleClick:
        self.show_normal_from_tray()

def show_normal_from_tray(self):
    self.show()
    self.setWindowState(self.windowState() & ~QtCore.Qt.WindowMinimized | QtCore.Qt.WindowActive)
    self.raise_()
    self.activateWindow()

def closeEvent(self, e: QtGui.QCloseEvent):
    ret = QtWidgets.QMessageBox.question(
        self, "Exit",
        "Keep running in the system tray?\nClick 'No' to quit.",
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes | QtWidgets.QMessageBox.No,
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes
    )
    if ret == QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes:
        e.ignore(); self.hide()
    else:
        e.ignore(); self.quit_app()

def on_request_restart(self, new_dir: Path):
    self.config.data["data_dir"] = str(new_dir); self.config.save()
    QtWidgets.QMessageBox.information(self, "Restart Required", "Settings changed. The launcher will restart now.")
    self._restart_self()

def _restart_self(self):
    python = sys.executable; args = sys.argv[:]
    QtCore.QProcess.startDetached(python, args)
    self.quit_app(force=True)

def quit_app(self, force: bool = False):
    if force:
        QtWidgets.QApplication.quit(); return
    def _finish(): QtWidgets.QApplication.quit()
    try:
        self.procman.bulk_stop_finished.disconnect()
    except Exception:
        pass
    self.procman.bulk_stop_finished.connect(_finish)
    self.procman.kill_all_async()

python3.11 -m pip install --upgrade build
python3.11 -m build            # produces dist/*.whl and dist/*.tar.gz

    notes / knobs you can tweak later

    • set real defaults via env:

      • COMFYUI_WORKDIR (e.g., /opt/comfyui)

      • COMFYUI_EXEC (e.g., bash -lc "source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate comfy && python main.py --listen --port {port}")

      • BROWSER_PATH (defaults to /path/to/chrome; or patch config.data["browser_path"])

    • the Open Web button only enables once the port is actually listening.

    • logs stream live into the console (and also append to <data_dir>/logs/*.log).

    • the instance list is scrollable and won’t grow the window height.

    • clean shutdown: all QProcess children and spawned browser PIDs are terminated before exit.

    인용문(this file wires everything…)이 있으니 뭔가 markdown syntax가 깨지는데 app.py 만 다시 써줘 

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import os
import sys
import socket
import signal
import json
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Optional, List
from importlib import resources

from PySide6 import QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets

from .ansi import ansi_to_html
from .qss_light import QSS

# ----------------------- App Constants -----------------------

APP_NAME = "HyperFlow Launcher"
CONFIG_PATH = str(Path.home() / ".hyperflow_launcher.json")

# Overridable via environment variables
COMFYUI_WORKDIR = os.environ.get("COMFYUI_WORKDIR", "/opt/comfyui")
COMFYUI_EXEC = os.environ.get("COMFYUI_EXEC", "python3 main.py --listen --port {port}")
BROWSER_DEFAULT = os.environ.get("BROWSER_PATH", "/path/to/chrome")

BIND_ADDR = "127.0.0.1"
MAX_INSTANCES = 8

# ----------------------- Utilities -----------------------

def app_icon() -> QtGui.QIcon:
    """Load icon from package assets; fallback to system icon if not found."""
    try:
        icon_data = (resources.files(__package__) / "assets" / "icon.png").read_bytes()
        pm = QtGui.QPixmap()
        if pm.loadFromData(icon_data):
            return QtGui.QIcon(pm)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return QtWidgets.QApplication.style().standardIcon(QtWidgets.QStyle.SP_ComputerIcon)

def is_port_in_use(port: int, host: str = BIND_ADDR, timeout: float = 0.2) -> bool:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        s.settimeout(timeout)
        try:
            return s.connect_ex((host, port)) == 0
        except OSError:
            return False

def reserve_free_port(host: str = BIND_ADDR) -> int:
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    s.bind((host, 0))
    port = s.getsockname()[1]
    s.close()
    return port

# ----------------------- Data Model -----------------------

@dataclass
class Instance:
    name: str
    port: int
    cwd: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    log_path: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    proc: Optional[QtCore.QProcess] = None
    pid: Optional[int] = None
    chrome_pids: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: str = "STOPPED"  # STARTING / RUNNING / STOPPED
    log_fh: Optional[object] = None      # optional: also persist stream to file

# ----------------------- Config -----------------------

class ConfigManager:
    """Handle load/save of persistent user settings (data_dir, browser_path)."""

    def __init__(self, path: str):
        self.path = path
        self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT}
        self.load()

    def load(self):
        if not os.path.exists(self.path):
            return
        try:
            with open(self.path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                self.data.update(json.load(f))
        except Exception:
            self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT}

    def save(self):
        with open(self.path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self.data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    @property
    def data_dir(self) -> Optional[Path]:
        dd = self.data.get("data_dir", "")
        return Path(dd) if dd else None

    @property
    def browser_path(self) -> str:
        return self.data.get("browser_path") or BROWSER_DEFAULT

# ----------------------- Welcome Dialog -----------------------

class WelcomeDialog(QtWidgets.QDialog):
    """First-run dialog to select the data directory."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Welcome to HyperFlow!")
        self.setWindowIcon(app_icon())
        self.setModal(True)
        self.resize(520, 200)

        label = QtWidgets.QLabel(
            "Welcome to HyperFlow!\n"
            "Please Select a Data Directory\n"
            "This is where application data (workflows, etc.) will be installed."
        )
        label.setWordWrap(True)

        self.path_edit = QtWidgets.QLineEdit()
        self.path_edit.setPlaceholderText("Choose a directory for HyperFlow data…")
        browse_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Browse…")
        browse_btn.clicked.connect(self.on_browse)

        path_row = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        path_row.addWidget(self.path_edit)
        path_row.addWidget(browse_btn)

        cancel_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Cancel")
        cont_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Continue")
        cancel_btn.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        cont_btn.clicked.connect(self.accept)

        btn_row = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        btn_row.addStretch()
        btn_row.addWidget(cancel_btn)
        btn_row.addWidget(cont_btn)

        v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        v.addWidget(label)
        v.addLayout(path_row)
        v.addStretch()
        v.addLayout(btn_row)

    def on_browse(self):
        d = QtWidgets.QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select Data Directory")
        if d:
            self.path_edit.setText(d)

    def selected_path(self) -> str:
        return self.path_edit.text().strip()

# ----------------------- Process Manager (QProcess streaming) -----------------------

class ProcessManagerLocal(QtCore.QObject):
    """Manage local child processes for HyperFlow instances using QProcess."""

    status_updated = QtCore.Signal()
    bulk_stop_finished = QtCore.Signal()
    log_received = QtCore.Signal(int, str)   # (port, text)

    def __init__(self, data_dir: Path, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.data_dir = data_dir
        self.instances: Dict[int, Instance] = {}
        (self.data_dir / "instances").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.data_dir / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (self.data_dir / "tmp").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        # Fast poll so STARTING→RUNNING flips when port is listening
        self.poll_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self.poll_timer.timeout.connect(self.poll_status)
        self.poll_timer.start(800)

        self._bulk_stop_check_timer: Optional[QtCore.QTimer] = None

    def create_instance(self) -> Instance:
        if len(self.instances) >= MAX_INSTANCES:
            raise RuntimeError("Maximum number of instances reached.")
        port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
        if is_port_in_use(port):
            port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
        name = f"HyperFlow-{port}"
        cwd = self.data_dir / "instances" / name
        cwd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log_path = self.data_dir / "logs" / f"{name}.log"
        inst = Instance(name=name, port=port, cwd=cwd, log_path=log_path)
        self.instances[port] = inst
        return inst

    def start_instance(self, inst: Instance):
        if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
            return
        if is_port_in_use(inst.port):
            new_port = reserve_free_port(BIND_ADDR)
            if is_port_in_use(new_port):
                QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Port Error", "Failed to acquire a free port. Please try again.")
                return
            inst.port = new_port

        cmd = COMFYUI_EXEC.format(port=inst.port)

        p = QtCore.QProcess(self)
        p.setWorkingDirectory(COMFYUI_WORKDIR)
        p.setProcessChannelMode(QtCore.QProcess.MergedChannels)
        p.setProgram("/bin/bash")
        p.setArguments(["-lc", cmd])

        def _on_ready():
            try:
                data = bytes(p.readAllStandardOutput()).decode("utf-8", "ignore")
            except Exception:
                return
            if not data:
                return
            if inst.log_fh is None:
                try:
                    inst.log_fh = open(inst.log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8")
                except Exception:
                    inst.log_fh = None
            if inst.log_fh:
                try:
                    inst.log_fh.write(data)
                    inst.log_fh.flush()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.log_received.emit(inst.port, data)

        def _on_finished(code, status):
            if inst.log_fh:
                try:
                    inst.log_fh.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                inst.log_fh = None
            inst.proc = None
            inst.pid = None
            inst.status = "STOPPED"
            for pid in list(inst.chrome_pids):
                try:
                    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
            inst.chrome_pids.clear()
            self.status_updated.emit()

        p.readyReadStandardOutput.connect(_on_ready)
        p.finished.connect(_on_finished)

        inst.status = "STARTING"
        p.start()
        if not p.waitForStarted(3000):
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Start Error", "Failed to start process.")
            inst.status = "STOPPED"
            return
        inst.proc = p
        inst.pid = int(p.processId()) if p.processId() is not None else None
        self.status_updated.emit()

    def stop_instance_async(self, inst: Instance, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
        if not inst.proc:
            return
        try:
            inst.proc.terminate()  # graceful
        except Exception:
            pass
        pid = inst.pid

        def _force_kill():
            if inst.proc and inst.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
                if pid:
                    try:
                        os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    except ProcessLookupError:
                        pass
                try:
                    inst.proc.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass

        QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(int(timeout_sec * 1000), _force_kill)

    def kill_all_async(self, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
        running = [i for i in self.instances.values()
                   if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
        if not running:
            QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(0, self.bulk_stop_finished.emit)
            return

        if self._bulk_stop_check_timer is None:
            self._bulk_stop_check_timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)

        self._bulk_stop_check_timer.setInterval(300)

        def _tick():
            alive = [i for i in self.instances.values()
                     if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
            if not alive:
                self._bulk_stop_check_timer.stop()
                self.bulk_stop_finished.emit()

        try:
            self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self._bulk_stop_check_timer.timeout.connect(_tick)
        self._bulk_stop_check_timer.start()

        for inst in running:
            self.stop_instance_async(inst, timeout_sec)

    def poll_status(self):
        changed = False
        for inst in self.instances.values():
            prev = inst.status
            if not inst.proc or inst.proc.state() == QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning:
                if prev != "STOPPED":
                    inst.status = "STOPPED"
                    changed = True
                continue
            inst.status = "RUNNING" if is_port_in_use(inst.port) else "STARTING"
            if inst.status != prev:
                changed = True
        if changed:
            self.status_updated.emit()

    def open_web(self, inst: Instance, browser_path: str):
        url = f"http://localhost:{inst.port}"
        try:
            p = subprocess.Popen([browser_path, url])
            inst.chrome_pids.append(p.pid)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(
                None, "Browser Not Found",
                f"The browser path is invalid:\n{browser_path}"
            )

# ----------------------- UI: Instance Card -----------------------

class InstanceCard(QtWidgets.QFrame):
    """One instance with actions and an embedded collapsible console."""

    start_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)
    stop_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)
    openweb_clicked = QtCore.Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, inst: Instance, procman: ProcessManagerLocal, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.inst = inst
        self.procman = procman
        self.setObjectName("card")
        self.setAttribute(QtCore.Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)

        self._anim_tick = 0  # for STARTING... animation

        name_lbl = QtWidgets.QLabel(f"{inst.name}")
        name_lbl.setObjectName("h2")
        self.subtitle = QtWidgets.QLabel(self._subtitle_text())
        self.subtitle.setObjectName("subtle")

        self.start_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Start")
        self.stop_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Stop")
        self.web_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Open Web")

        self.start_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.start_clicked.emit(inst.port))
        self.stop_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.stop_clicked.emit(inst.port))
        self.web_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.openweb_clicked.emit(inst.port))

        # Console toggle + view
        self.console_toggle = QtWidgets.QToolButton()
        self.console_toggle.setObjectName("consoleToggle")
        self.console_toggle.setText("Console")
        self.console_toggle.setCheckable(True)
        self.console_toggle.setArrowType(QtCore.Qt.RightArrow)
        self.console_toggle.setToolButtonStyle(QtCore.Qt.ToolButtonTextBesideIcon)
        self.console_toggle.toggled.connect(self._on_console_toggled)

        self.console_view = QtWidgets.QTextBrowser()
        self.console_view.setObjectName("console")
        self.console_view.setReadOnly(True)
        self.console_view.setHidden(True)
        self.console_view.document().setMaximumBlockCount(5000)
        self.console_view.setAutoFillBackground(False)

        header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        header.addWidget(name_lbl)
        header.addStretch()
        header.addWidget(self.subtitle)

        actions = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        actions.addStretch()
        actions.addWidget(self.start_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.stop_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.web_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.console_toggle)

        v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        v.addLayout(header)
        v.addLayout(actions)
        v.addWidget(self.console_view)

        # STARTING animation timer
        self.anim_timer = QtWidgets.QTimer(self)
        self.anim_timer.setInterval(1000)
        self.anim_timer.timeout.connect(self._animate_starting)
        self._sync_anim_timer()

        # connect live logs (even when console is collapsed)
        self.procman.log_received.connect(self._on_log)

        self.update_buttons()

    def _subtitle_text(self) -> str:
        if self.inst.status == "STARTING":
            dots = "." * ((self._anim_tick % 3) + 1)
            return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: STARTING{dots}"
        return f"Port {self.inst.port} • Status: {self.inst.status}"

    def _sync_anim_timer(self):
        if self.inst.status == "STARTING" and not self.anim_timer.isActive():
            self.anim_timer.start()
        elif self.inst.status != "STARTING" and self.anim_timer.isActive():
            self.anim_timer.stop()

    def _animate_starting(self):
        if self.inst.status != "STARTING":
            self._sync_anim_timer()
            return
        self._anim_tick += 1
        self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())

    def _on_console_toggled(self, checked: bool):
        self.console_toggle.setArrowType(
            QtCore.Qt.DownArrow if checked else QtCore.Qt.RightArrow
        )
        self.console_view.setHidden(not checked)

    @QtCore.Slot(int, str)
    def _on_log(self, port: int, text: str):
        if port != self.inst.port:
            return
        html = ansi_to_html(text)
        self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)
        self.console_view.insertHtml(html)
        self.console_view.moveCursor(QtGui.QTextCursor.End)

    def update_view(self, inst: Instance):
        self.inst = inst
        self._sync_anim_timer()
        self.subtitle.setText(self._subtitle_text())
        self.update_buttons()

    def update_buttons(self):
        running = self.inst.status == "RUNNING"
        starting = self.inst.status == "STARTING"
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(not running and not starting)
        self.stop_btn.setEnabled(running or starting)
        self.web_btn.setEnabled(running)

# ----------------------- Pages -----------------------

class HyperFlowPage(QtWidgets.QWidget):
    """Main page listing instances with a scrollable card list."""

    def __init__(self, procman: ProcessManagerLocal, browser_path: str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.procman = procman
        self.browser_path = browser_path
        self._auto_open_done = False

        title = QtWidgets.QLabel("HyperFlow")
        title.setObjectName("h1")
        add_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("New Instance")
        add_btn.setObjectName("primary")
        add_btn.clicked.connect(self.on_add)

        header = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout()
        header.addWidget(title)
        header.addStretch()
        header.addWidget(add_btn)

        # Scrollable card list
        self.cards_container = QtWidgets.QWidget()
        self.cards_layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self.cards_container)
        self.cards_layout.setSpacing(10)
        self.cards_layout.addStretch(1)

        scroll = QtWidgets.QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidget(self.cards_container)
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll.setFrameShape(QtWidgets.QFrame.NoFrame)
        scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        # Keep scroll visuals clean without forcing opaque fills
        scroll.setAutoFillBackground(False)
        scroll.viewport().setAutoFillBackground(False)

        outer = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.addLayout(header)
        outer.addSpacing(8)
        outer.addWidget(scroll, 1)

        procman.status_updated.connect(self.refresh)

        # Ensure at least one card; auto-start and auto-open web when ready
        if not self.procman.instances:
            card = self.on_add()
            if card:
                QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(50, lambda: self._auto_start_and_open(card))

        self.refresh()

    def on_add(self) -> Optional[InstanceCard]:
        try:
            inst = self.procman.create_instance()
        except Exception as e:
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(self, "Create Failed", str(e))
            return None
        card = InstanceCard(inst, self.procman)
        # Insert above the stretch
        self.cards_layout.insertWidget(self.cards_layout.count() - 1, card)

        # Hook actions
        card.start_clicked.connect(self.on_start)
        card.stop_clicked.connect(self.on_stop)
        card.openweb_clicked.connect(self.on_openweb)
        return card

    def _auto_start_and_open(self, card: InstanceCard):
        inst = card.inst
        self.procman.start_instance(inst)

        def maybe_open():
            if self._auto_open_done:
                return
            cur = self.procman.instances.get(inst.port)
            if cur and cur.status == "RUNNING":
                self._auto_open_done = True
                self.procman.open_web(cur, self.browser_path)
                try:
                    self.procman.status_updated.disconnect(maybe_open)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        self.procman.status_updated.connect(maybe_open)

    def on_start(self, port: int):
        inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
        if inst:
            self.procman.start_instance(inst)

    def on_stop(self, port: int):
        inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
        if inst:
            self.procman.stop_instance_async(inst)

    def on_openweb(self, port: int):
        inst = self.procman.instances.get(port)
        if inst:
            self.procman.open_web(inst, self.browser_path)

    @QtCore.Slot()
    def refresh(self):
        for i in range(self.cards_layout.count() - 1):  # skip final stretch
            w = self.cards_layout.itemAt(i).widget()
            if isinstance(w, InstanceCard):
                inst = self.procman.instances.get(w.inst.port)
                if inst:
                    w.update_view(inst)

class SettingsWidget(QtWidgets.QWidget):
    """Settings page (currently only data directory)."""

    request_restart = QtCore.Signal(Path)

    def __init__(self, config: ConfigManager, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.config = config

        title = QtWidgets.QLabel("Settings")
        title.setObjectName("h1")

        data_label = QtWidgets.QLabel("Data Directory")
        self.data_edit = QtWidgets.QLineEdit(str(config.data_dir or ""))
        self.data_edit.setPlaceholderText("Path to HyperFlow data directory")
        data_browse = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Browse…")
        data_browse.clicked.connect(self.on_browse)

        grid = QtWidgets.QGridLayout()
        grid.addWidget(data_label, 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.data_edit, 0, 1)
        grid.addWidget(data_browse, 0, 2)

        info = QtWidgets.QLabel("Changing the data directory will restart the launcher.")
        save_btn = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Apply & Restart")
        save_btn.clicked.connect(self.apply_and_restart)

        card = QtWidgets.QFrame()
        card.setObjectName("card")
        card.setAttribute(QtCore.Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        card_l = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(card)
        card_l.addLayout(grid)
        card_l.addWidget(info)
        card_l.addStretch()
        card_l.addWidget(save_btn, alignment=QtCore.Qt.AlignRight)

        v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        v.addWidget(title)
        v.addSpacing(8)
        v.addWidget(card, 1)

    def on_browse(self):
        d = QtWidgets.QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select Data Directory")
        if d:
            self.data_edit.setText(d)

    def apply_and_restart(self):
        new_path = Path(self.data_edit.text().strip())
        if not new_path.exists():
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(self, "Invalid Path", "The selected path does not exist.")
            return
        self.request_restart.emit(new_path)

class Sidebar(QtWidgets.QFrame):
    """Flat sidebar with two nav buttons: HyperFlow (top) and Settings (bottom)."""

    indexChanged = QtCore.Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("sidebar")

        self.btn_hf = QtWidgets.QPushButton("HyperFlow")
        self.btn_hf.setCheckable(True)
        self.btn_hf.setObjectName("nav")

        self.btn_settings = QtWidgets.QPushButton("Settings")
        self.btn_settings.setCheckable(True)
        self.btn_settings.setObjectName("nav")

        self.btn_hf.clicked.connect(lambda: self._activate(0))
        self.btn_settings.clicked.connect(lambda: self._activate(1))

        top_box = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout()
        top_box.setContentsMargins(12, 12, 12, 12)
        top_box.setSpacing(8)
        top_box.addWidget(self.btn_hf)

        bottom_box = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout()
        bottom_box.setContentsMargins(12, 12, 12, 12)
        bottom_box.setSpacing(8)
        bottom_box.addWidget(self.btn_settings)

        v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        v.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        v.setSpacing(0)

        top_wrap = QtWidgets.QFrame()
        top_wrap.setObjectName("sidebarSection")
        top_wrap.setLayout(top_box)

        bottom_wrap = QtWidgets.QFrame()
        bottom_wrap.setObjectName("sidebarSection")
        bottom_wrap.setLayout(bottom_box)

        v.addWidget(top_wrap)
        v.addStretch(1)
        v.addWidget(bottom_wrap)

        self._activate(0)

    def _activate(self, idx: int):
        self.btn_hf.setChecked(idx == 0)
        self.btn_settings.setChecked(idx == 1)
        self.indexChanged.emit(idx)

class MainWindow(QtWidgets.QMainWindow):
    """Main window with sidebar, stacked pages, system tray, and graceful shutdown."""

    def __init__(self, config: ConfigManager):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.setWindowTitle(APP_NAME)
        self.setWindowIcon(app_icon())

        # Layout
        self.sidebar = Sidebar()
        self.sidebar.indexChanged.connect(self.on_sidebar_index)

        self.procman = ProcessManagerLocal(config.data_dir)
        self.page_hf = HyperFlowPage(self.procman, config.browser_path)
        self.page_settings = SettingsWidget(config)
        self.page_settings.request_restart.connect(self.on_request_restart)

        self.stack = QtWidgets.QStackedWidget()
        self.stack.addWidget(self.page_hf)
        self.stack.addWidget(self.page_settings)

        content_wrap = QtWidgets.QFrame()
        content_wrap.setObjectName("content")
        content_layout = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(content_wrap)
        content_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 16, 16, 16)
        content_layout.addWidget(self.stack)

        central = QtWidgets.QWidget()
        h = QtWidgets.QHBoxLayout(central)
        h.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        h.setSpacing(0)
        h.addWidget(self.sidebar)
        h.addWidget(content_wrap, 1)
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        # Tray
        self._create_tray()

        # Geometry + theme
        self.resize(1120, 720)
        self._apply_qss()

    def _apply_qss(self):
        self.setStyleSheet(QSS)

    def on_sidebar_index(self, idx: int):
        self.stack.setCurrentIndex(idx)

    def _create_tray(self):
        self.tray = QtWidgets.QSystemTrayIcon(self)
        self.tray.setIcon(app_icon())
        self.tray.setToolTip(APP_NAME)
        self.tray.activated.connect(self.on_tray_activated)

        menu = QtWidgets.QMenu()
        show_act = menu.addAction("Show Window")
        quit_act = menu.addAction("Quit")
        show_act.triggered.connect(self.show_normal_from_tray)
        quit_act.triggered.connect(self.quit_app)
        self.tray.setContextMenu(menu)
        self.tray.show()

    def on_tray_activated(self, reason):
        if reason == QtWidgets.QSystemTrayIcon.DoubleClick:
            self.show_normal_from_tray()

    def show_normal_from_tray(self):
        self.show()
        self.setWindowState(self.windowState() & ~QtCore.Qt.WindowMinimized | QtCore.Qt.WindowActive)
        self.raise_()
        self.activateWindow()

    def closeEvent(self, e: QtGui.QCloseEvent):
        ret = QtWidgets.QMessageBox.question(
            self, "Exit",
            "Keep running in the system tray?\nClick 'No' to quit.",
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes | QtWidgets.QMessageBox.No,
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes
        )
        if ret == QtWidgets.QMessageBox.Yes:
            e.ignore()
            self.hide()
        else:
            e.ignore()
            self.quit_app()

    def on_request_restart(self, new_dir: Path):
        self.config.data["data_dir"] = str(new_dir)
        self.config.save()
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.information(self, "Restart Required", "Settings changed. The launcher will restart now.")
        self._restart_self()

    def _restart_self(self):
        python = sys.executable
        args = sys.argv[:]
        QtCore.QProcess.startDetached(python, args)
        self.quit_app(force=True)

    def quit_app(self, force: bool = False):
        if force:
            QtWidgets.QApplication.quit()
            return

        def _finish():
            QtWidgets.QApplication.quit()

        try:
            self.procman.bulk_stop_finished.disconnect()
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.procman.bulk_stop_finished.connect(_finish)
        self.procman.kill_all_async()

# ----------------------- First-run Validation & Entrypoint -----------------------

def validate_or_welcome(config: ConfigManager) -> bool:
    """Ensure a valid data directory; show welcome flow when absent."""
    dd = config.data_dir
    if dd and dd.exists() and dd.is_dir():
        return True

    dlg = WelcomeDialog()
    if dlg.exec() != QtWidgets.QDialog.Accepted:
        return False

    sel = dlg.selected_path()
    if not sel:
        return False

    p = Path(sel)
    if not p.exists():
        try:
            p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except Exception as e:
            QtWidgets.QMessageBox.critical(None, "Error", f"Failed to create directory:\n{e}")
            return False

    for sub in ("instances", "logs", "tmp"):
        (p / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    config.data["data_dir"] = str(p)
    config.save()
    return True

def main():
    app = QtWidgets.QApplication(sys.argv)
    app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
    app.setWindowIcon(app_icon())

    config = ConfigManager(CONFIG_PATH)
    if not validate_or_welcome(config):
        return 0

    w = MainWindow(config)
    w.show()
    return app.exec()

    추가 개발 요청 1. 웹 자동 실행 옵션을 넣어서(설정에 체크박스로 설정) 포트가 use 된 걸 확인 후 크롬을 띄워주도록 한다(instance 당 1번). 2. 툴이 꺼질 때 kill을 하지말고 무조건 instance들은 terminate를 하고 모두 꺼질때까지 기다린다. 창을 하나 띄워서 꺼지는 걸 로그로 보여주도록 한다. 3. x 버튼을 누르면 질문하는 대신 무조건 tray로 일단 들어간다. 그 때 안내 메시지로 여기 트레이로 들어갔다고 표시한다. 트레이를 우클릭해서 끄는건 2번과 같이 꺼지도록 한다. 4. chrome은 툴이 꺼질 때 따로 종료하지 않는다. chrome process 들 리스트를 따로 관리할 필요도 없을 듯하다.(QProcess detach로 실행한다) 변경된 내용만 app.py 에 반영해서 다시 알려주

    좋아! 아래는 app.py에서 바뀐 부분만 모아서 준 패치예요.
    (복붙해서 기존 동일 위치/함수에 교체 하거나, 표시된 라인들을 추가 하면 됩니다.)

    1) Config: 자동 웹 실행 플래그 추가

    변경(초기값/로드/프로퍼티 추가)

    # --- in ConfigManager.__init__ (defaults) ---
self.data = {
    "data_dir": "",
    "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT,
    "auto_open_web": False,          # NEW: auto open web option
}

# --- in ConfigManager.load() (fallback on error) ---
self.data = {"data_dir": "", "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT, "auto_open_web": False}

# --- add property ---
@property
def auto_open_web(self) -> bool:
    return bool(self.data.get("auto_open_web", False))

    2) Instance 모델: 크롬 PID 추적 제거

    변경(필드 삭제)

    @dataclass
class Instance:
    ...
    # REMOVE: chrome_pids: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)

    이후 크롬 관련 정리 코드도 모두 삭제/수정(아래에 포함).

    3) ProcessManager: 크롬 분리 실행(detached) + 종료 정책 변경

    3-1) 크롬 실행 방식: 분리 실행 & 추적 안 함

    변경(open_web):

    def open_web(self, inst: Instance, browser_path: str):
    url = f"http://localhost:{inst.port}"
    # startDetached: no PID tracking, won't be killed by the app
    ok = QtCore.QProcess.startDetached(browser_path, [url])
    if not ok:
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(
            None, "Browser Not Found",
            f"The browser path is invalid or failed to launch:\n{browser_path}"
        )

    3-2) 인스턴스 종료: terminate만 보내고, kill 금지

    변경(stop_instance_async):

    def stop_instance_async(self, inst: Instance, timeout_sec: float = 5.0):
    if not inst.proc:
        return
    try:
        inst.proc.terminate()  # graceful only
    except Exception:
        pass
    # NOTE: no force kill anymore per requirement

    3-3) 프로세스 종료 핸들러에서 크롬 정리 제거

    변경(_on_finished 내부):

    def _on_finished(code, status):
    if inst.log_fh:
        try: inst.log_fh.close()
        except Exception: pass
        inst.log_fh = None
    inst.proc = None
    inst.pid = None
    inst.status = "STOPPED"
    # REMOVE: chrome_pids termination/clear (no longer tracked)
    self.status_updated.emit()

    4) Settings: “Auto open web” 체크박스 추가 (재시작 불필요)

    변경(SettingsWidget.init): (체크박스 UI/저장 버튼 추가)

self.auto_open_chk.setChecked(config.auto_open_web)

# put it into the card layout (e.g., above info)

# change Apply button handler to save this flag immediately (no restart needed)
def apply_and_restart(self):
    new_path = Path(self.data_edit.text().strip())
    if not new_path.exists():
        QtWidgets.QMessageBox.warning(self, "Invalid Path", "The selected path does not exist.")
        return
    # save both settings
    self.config.data["auto_open_web"] = self.auto_open_chk.isChecked()   # NEW
    self.request_restart.emit(new_path)  # data_dir change still triggers restart

    만약 데이터 디렉토리를 변경하지 않고 체크박스만 바꿨을 때 재시작 없이 저장하고 싶다면, 아래 추가 도 함께 적용: ```python

    ADD a new slot inside SettingsWidget:

    def apply_without_restart(self): self.config.data["auto_open_web"] = self.auto_open_chk.isChecked() self.config.save() QtWidgets.QMessageBox.information(self, "Saved", "Settings saved.")

    그리고 별도의 버튼을 하나 더 만들거나,

    기존 "Apply & Restart" 옆에 "Save" 버튼을 추가해서 connect(self.apply_without_restart)

    
(버튼 분리는 취향입니다. 간단히 하려면 지금처럼 `Apply & Restart` 클릭 시 두 값 모두 저장해도 됩니다.)

## 5) HyperFlowPage: “자동 웹 실행” 로직(포트 리스닝 확인 뒤, **인스턴스당 1회** 실행)

**변경(필드/초기화):**
```python
self._opened_ports_once: set[int] = set()  # NEW: track opened ports once-per-instance

    변경(_auto_start_and_open):
    기존에는 무조건 한 번 열었는데, 이제 설정 값에 따라, 그리고 포트 리스닝 상태에서 1회만 열도록 변경.

    def _auto_start_and_open(self, card: InstanceCard):

    self.procman.start_instance(inst)

        # open only if RUNNING (port listening) + setting enabled + not yet opened
        from .app import ConfigManager  # (or capture config via constructor; here we access via parent chain if needed)
        # Prefer passing config into this page; but if not, use parent page_settings/config
        # Assuming we can access via main window pointer:
        mw = self.window()
        cfg = None
        if hasattr(mw, "config"):
            cfg = mw.config
        auto = bool(cfg and cfg.auto_open_web)
        if auto and cur.status == "RUNNING" and cur.port not in self._opened_ports_once:
            self._opened_ports_once.add(cur.port)
            self.procman.open_web(cur, self.browser_path)
            try: self.procman.status_updated.disconnect(maybe_open)
            except Exception: pass

    # Make sure we only connect once per instance

    except Exception: pass
    self.procman.status_updated.connect(maybe_open)

    만약 HyperFlowPage 생성자에서 config를 받아서 self.config로 들고 있게 하면 더 깔끔합니다.

    추가(간단한 종료 진행 대화상자)

    class ShutdownDialog(QtWidgets.QDialog):
    """Modal dialog to show graceful termination logs while waiting."""
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Shutting down")
        self.setWindowIcon(app_icon())
        self.setModal(True)
        self.resize(520, 260)

        self.log = QtWidgets.QTextEdit()
        self.log.setReadOnly(True)

        v = QtWidgets.QVBoxLayout(self)
        v.addWidget(lbl)
        v.addWidget(self.log)

    def append(self, text: str):
        self.log.append(text)

    변경(MainWindow.quit_app):

    • 강제 종료 경로 제거

    • 모달 ShutdownDialog 띄우고, 모든 인스턴스에 terminate() 보낸 뒤 주기적으로 상태 확인 , 전부 꺼지면 앱 종료

    def quit_app(self, force: bool = False):
    if force:
        QtWidgets.QApplication.quit()
        return

    # 1) show modal shutdown dialog
    dlg = ShutdownDialog(self)
    dlg.show()
    QtWidgets.QApplication.processEvents(QtCore.QEventLoop.AllEvents, 50)

    # 2) send terminate to all running instances (no kill)
    running = [i for i in self.procman.instances.values()
               if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
    for inst in running:
        dlg.append(f"Sending terminate to {inst.name} (port {inst.port})")
        self.procman.stop_instance_async(inst, timeout_sec=5.0)  # will only terminate

    # 3) poll until all stopped
    def check_done():
        alive = [i for i in self.procman.instances.values()
                 if i.proc and i.proc.state() != QtCore.QProcess.NotRunning]
        for i in alive:
            # optional: per-loop info
            pass
        if not alive:
            dlg.append("All instances have exited. Goodbye.")
            QtCore.QTimer.singleShot(200, QtWidgets.QApplication.quit)

    # Use a short-interval timer while dialog is visible
    t = QtCore.QTimer(self)
    t.setInterval(300)
    t.timeout.connect(lambda: (self.procman.poll_status(), check_done()))
    t.start()

    # Make sure the dialog stays modal until quit
    dlg.exec()

    변경(Tray “Quit” 액션 핸들러): (이미 quit_app을 호출하고 있으니 그대로 동작)

    # in _create_tray()
quit_act.triggered.connect(self.quit_app)  # already there; now it shows graceful dialog

    요약

    • 설정에 Auto open web 체크박스 추가 → 저장되면 포트가 리스닝될 때 인스턴스당 1회 만 자동 브라우저 오픈.

    • 브라우저는 QProcess.startDetached 로 실행 → 추적/종료 관리 안 함.

    • 종료 시 : X 버튼 → 바로 트레이로 (토스트 메시지). Tray Quit → terminate만 보내고, 모달 로그 창 에서 종료 과정을 보여주며 모두 끝날 때까지 대기.

    • 강제 KILL 제거 : 더 이상 SIGKILL 안 씀.

    원하면 위 패치를 반영한 완전체 app.py도 바로 만들어줄게.

    너의 제안 사항 포함해서 app.py 전체 파일 작성 부탁해 

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import os
import sys
import socket
import json
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Optional, List
from importlib import resources

from PySide6 import QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets

from .ansi import ansi_to_html
from .qss_light import QSS

# ----------------------- App Constants -----------------------

APP_NAME = "HyperFlow Launcher"
CONFIG_PATH = str(Path.home() / ".hyperflow_launcher.json")

# Overridable via environment variables
COMFYUI_WORKDIR = os.environ.get("COMFYUI_WORKDIR", "/opt/comfyui")
COMFYUI_EXEC = os.environ.get("COMFYUI_EXEC", "python3 main.py --listen --port {port}")
BROWSER_DEFAULT = os.environ.get("BROWSER_PATH", "/path/to/chrome")

BIND_ADDR = "127.0.0.1"
MAX_INSTANCES = 8

# ----------------------- Utilities -----------------------

def app_icon() -> QtGui.QIcon:
    """Load icon from package assets; fallback to system icon if not found."""
    try:
        icon_data = (resources.files(__package__) / "assets" / "icon.png").read_bytes()
        pm = QtGui.QPixmap()
        if pm.loadFromData(icon_data):
            return QtGui.QIcon(pm)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return QtWidgets.QApplication.style().standardIcon(QtWidgets.QStyle.SP_ComputerIcon)

def is_port_in_use(port: int, host: str = BIND_ADDR, timeout: float = 0.2) -> bool:
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        s.settimeout(timeout)
        try:
            return s.connect_ex((host, port)) == 0
        except OSError:
            return False

def reserve_free_port(host: str = BIND_ADDR) -> int:
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
    s.bind((host, 0))
    port = s.getsockname()[1]
    s.close()
    return port

# ----------------------- Data Model -----------------------

@dataclass
class Instance:
    name: str
    port: int
    cwd: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    log_path: Path = field(default_factory=Path)
    proc: Optional[QtCore.QProcess] = None
    pid: Optional[int] = None
    status: str = "STOPPED"  # STARTING / RUNNING / STOPPED
    log_fh: Optional[object] = None  # optional: also persist stream to file

# ----------------------- Config -----------------------

class ConfigManager:
    """Handle load/save of persistent user settings (data_dir, browser_path, auto_open_web)."""

    def __init__(self, path: str):
        self.path = path
        self.data = {
            "data_dir": "",
            "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT,
            "auto_open_web": False,  # NEW: open web automatically per-instance once it's listening
        }
        self.load()

    def load(self):
        if not os.path.exists(self.path):
            return
        try:
            with open(self.path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                loaded = json.load(f)
                # keep defaults for missing keys
                self.data.update(loaded)
        except Exception:
            self.data = {
                "data_dir": "",
                "browser_path": BROWSER_DEFAULT,
                "auto_open_web": False,
            }

    def save(self):
        with open(self.path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(self.data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    @property
    def data_dir(self) -> Optional[Path]:
        dd = self.data.get("data_dir", "")
        return Path(dd) if dd else None

    @property
    def browser_path(self) -> str:
        return self.data.get("browser_path") or BROWSER_DEFAULT

    @property
    def auto_open_web(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.data.get("auto_open_web", False))
